notes.title: Patch Note 01
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
We just uploaded a new version of the game fixing some minor bugs we found.
To let you know, players reported that the game crashes with a "fatal error" sometimes. We are still looking for this bug and trying to find a way to fix it. If this happens to you, try to close the game and open it again. That should do the trick.

[h3]— PATCH NOTES —[/h3]

- Fixed a bug that made enemies from lvl 2 disappear.
- Edited a typo in the intro.

Thanks everyone for playing, and keep sending us comments. It really helps us to improve!
